content:
maya: Ok team — starting a region-phased rollout for service-api v2.4.1. Plan: US (phase A) -> EU (phase B) -> APAC (phase C). Please confirm capacity cushion and rollback rules. Target change window: 02:00-06:00 UTC.
liam: Confirming. What's our expected QPS and KV-cache hit assumptions for the US canary?
anika: +1 on QPS. Also do we want a progressive traffic carve (10% -> 30% -> 60%) or immediate 50% canary?
maya: US canary: 8k p95 QPS baseline, aim for 10% carve first (800 RPS), 3x warmup for KV cache. Safety cushion = reserve 30% spare GPU capacity.
liam: Sounds good. Will run load smoke from our test harness before canary. ETA for smoke: 20m after deploy starts.
rob: We'll pin routing rules to v2.4.1 for the canary slice only. If latency > 200ms p95 or error rate spikes > 0.8%, we auto-fallback to v2.4.0.
eva: Adding release notes: https://confluence.redwood/release/v2.4.1 — includes quantization fix and latency improvements for attention cache. Notify customers list is updated. :loudspeaker:
maya: Rollback window = first 30 minutes critical. If we don't hit green by then, we roll back. Manual canary hold via /rollout hold <region>.
deploy-bot: [2851122400] deploy-start service-api v2.4.1 -> US canary slice (10% traffic). Commit: a7b9f2c.
sre-bot: Preflight checks: GPU pool availability OK (us-west-2: 12 GPUs free), KV cache primed predicted hit 72%, autoscaler thresholds validated.
liam: Running smoke script: `./scripts/smoke.sh --target us-canary --rate 850` — posting initial logs.
liam: smoke log: 200/200 requests OK, p95=150ms, errors=0.1%
anika: Observability looks clean; tracing traces show normal tail latency. Recommend advance to 30% after 15m.
maya: Advancing to 30% at +15m if no regressions. Who's on rollback watch?
rob: I'm on rollback watch for the first 30m. If any spike we call rollback and pin to v2.4.0.
eva: I'll prepare customer comms in case we need a quick heads-up.
deploy-bot: [2851122410] traffic-update: US canary -> 30% traffic.
sre-bot: Telemetry: p95=162ms, error_rate=0.2%, CPU per-GPU within 68% avg, no OOMs.
liam: smoke rerun at 30%: 600/600 OK, p95=165ms.
anika: Approving EU phase prep — can we mirror the same carve times? EU start planned at +60m after US green.
maya: Yes EU will start +60m. APAC will start +180m. EU agents: reserve eu-central-1 extra pool (6 GPUs) as cushion.
rob: Rollback triggers summary I wrote up:
- p95 > 220ms sustained 3 consecutive 5m windows -> auto-fallback
- error_rate > 0.8% in 5m -> auto-fallback
- deployment failures on >2 nodes -> manual rollback
Placeholders for manual intervention: /rollout rollback <region> <reason>
liam: Noted. Also adding thermal threshold: if GPU temp sensors report sustained >85C on >50% of nodes, hold traffic.
sre-bot: Notified infra to watch thermal; alerts wired to #eng-oncall.
maya: US green at 45m. Moving to EU prep. EU capacity runway confirmed by infra. EU canary carve same pattern.
deploy-bot: [2851122440] deploy-start service-api v2.4.1 -> EU canary slice (10%).
liam: EU smoke @10%: 220/220 OK, p95=170ms.
rob: If EU shows >15% latency regression vs baseline, we hold and call page.
anika: APAC note: due to regional model shard differences, KV warmup may need 2x time — plan for 10m extra warmup before escalating traffic.
maya: Acknowledged. Final checklist: release notes link, config pin for canary routes, rollback playbook in Ops doc, contact list updated. Call sign-off: +maya +liam +rob +anika +eva. :white_check_mark:
rob: I'll post the postmortem template in case we need it.
sre-bot: Final telemetry summary will be archived to /releases/v2.4.1/telemetry after rollout complete.
maya: Closing thread — update if anything changes. Thanks all. :rocket:
